$description: Fable - a heyrav world. base: any theme; light/dark: per theme; voice: words reworded in this world. Keys are token names without the --.
name: Fable
line: A storybook: worn type, parchment and moss by day, a moonlit wood by night, and small wonders between the pages.

voice.searchph: Seek a component, a token, a pattern
voice.copied: Copied - kept safe in the clipboard
voice.copyfail: The spell slipped - select the code instead
voice.hero.p: Every token, component and pattern behind heyrav.in, told as a story - with a few small wonders tucked between the pages.
voice.lede.worlds: One tale, many worlds. The same components wake in a new land - new letters, colours, shapes and manners - at a touch, the way day turns to night.
voice.lede.typography: IM Fell English sets the titles, from types first cut in the 1670s. Alegreya, a calligraphic book face, carries the reading; Fell's own small capitals letter the labels.
voice.lede.colour: Parchment and moss by day, a moonlit wood by night. Emerald for the things that act, gold for the things that shine - and every text colour clears 4.5:1.
voice.lede.spacing: A storybook breathes: every step a quarter wider than Studio's, so a page never feels crowded.
voice.lede.radius: Soft corners, a little uneven, like pages that have been turned many times.
voice.lede.elevation: Things float the way paper does - a soft, warm shadow, never grey, and a pale edge where the light catches.
voice.lede.motion: Movements overshoot a touch and settle, like something alive. Reduced motion keeps every scene still.
voice.lede.icons: Phosphor Duotone: a line drawing with a wash of colour inside, like an illustration in a margin.
voice.lede.button: Emerald with a hair of gold leaf around it. Pressed, it gives a little; a success scatters a little glitter.
voice.lede.voice: Warm and unhurried, with a little wonder - but every label still says exactly what it does.
voice.lede.404: This page is not in the story. The search, or the first chapter, will find the path again.
voice.type.head: titles
voice.type.head.note: IM Fell English: the Fell types, revived with their ink spread and all.
voice.type.sans.note: Alegreya: calligraphic rhythm made for long passages, set with generous leading.
voice.type.em.note: Fell italic in emerald by day and gold by night - the word the sentence turns on.
voice.type.label: labels
voice.type.label.note: IM Fell English SC: true small capitals, never shouted.
voice.type.mono.note: The system monospace - spells should be exact.
voice.lede.chip: Luggage tags: a punched hole, an italic name. Chosen, the tag turns emerald and gains a small gold star.
voice.lede.badge: Small capitals; the solid one is a wax seal, pressed in rose.
voice.lede.card: A page with gilt dots at its corners and corners that are never quite even. Under the pointer it lifts and tilts, a little.
voice.lede.input: Parchment, a quill line, and a soft gold glow when it has focus.
voice.lede.checkbox: The tick is drawn with a pen, once, the moment it is checked - and a pinch of glitter follows.
voice.lede.switch: Its thumb is a firefly: pale when off, gold and glowing when on.
voice.lede.slider: A fine track and a gilded drop of light to hold.
voice.lede.tabs: Small capitals; the chosen one is underlined by hand, in a wavering line.
voice.lede.accordion: A heading in Fell type; the answer arrives in italic, as an aside.
voice.lede.dialog: A page from the book: a gilt rule inside the edge, opening with a slight turn as if lifted from a pile.
voice.lede.tooltip: A slip of paper with an italic note.
voice.lede.toast: A note sealed with wax - emerald for good news, rose for trouble.
voice.lede.progress: A vine that grows from moss to gold, with a leaf at its tip.
voice.lede.spinner: A firefly circling on a dotted path.
voice.lede.skeleton: Gold dust drifting across where the words will be.
voice.lede.avatar: Framed in gold, warmed a shade toward sepia.
voice.lede.link: Emerald words over a hair of gold; under the pointer the gold rises like a highlighter.
voice.lede.menu: Italic choices; the one in focus is lit with a wash of gold.
voice.lede.morph: Send the letter: a gold orbit while it travels, Delivered when it lands - with glitter - then the reply unfolds.
